name: bpb.paragraphs
description: Sarvam-1 bits per byte of every paragraph except the title (paragraph i = text.split('\n\n')[i]), with its percentile within its kind and length band. Each row's bits, bytes, tokens, pieces and scoring run are in the score store, joined on para_sha1 (see 'joins').
source: sarvamai/sarvam-1@e9607337286d, 3 scoring runs on RunPod GPUs (records: 'runs' in bpb.json), scores kept per text in raw/bpb/scores.jsonl.gz; score_bpb.py; corpus orwiki-20260901-trainingready.jsonl sha1 68c6a19f1bf4

columns.para: paragraph index; 0 (the title heading) is not scored
columns.para_sha1: sha1 of the paragraph text (UTF-8); the score belongs to exactly this text, and it is the key of the score store (see 'joins')
columns.kind: heading / list / table / math / text, from the leading characters (edaapp's rule; its 'para' = text)
columns.bpb: bits per UTF-8 byte (bits / bytes of the store row, see 'joins'); paragraphs over 1,000 characters are scored in whitespace-split pieces, as the eval harness does; null = the text has no score in the store yet (build --allow-missing; see 'unscored' in bpb.json)
columns.bpb_group: comparison group: kind x length band, pooled over the kind when under 400 paragraphs; only text/list/math >= 100 B and tables >= 200 B are compared (headings never); null when not compared or not scored
columns.bpb_pct: percentile of bpb within bpb_group (0-1); null when not compared or not scored
columns.bpb_z: robust z of log bpb within bpb_group ((x - median) / (1.4826 MAD)); null when not compared or not scored
columns.flag: 'high' = top 1%, 'low' = bottom 1% of bpb_group; null otherwise
columns.latin_share: share of the paragraph's letters and marks that are Latin script
columns.other_script_share: share that is neither Odia nor Latin (Devanagari, Bengali, ...)
columns.english_words: share of the Latin-script words that are common English words (null: under 5 Latin words)
columns.markup: conversion leftovers found outside math (tags, {{ }}, [[ ]], {| |}, px, URLs, namespace prefixes), if any
columns.verse: a prose block of 3+ short lines (poems, songs, shlokas)
columns.repeats: articles with a paragraph of the same sentence frame: digits, the article's title and words found in fewer than 20 articles masked (1 = unique or too little left to compare)
columns.self_repeat: share of word triples that repeat an earlier one in the same paragraph
columns.near_copies: other articles holding a near-copy (word-bigram Jaccard >= 0.5); computed only for paragraphs flagged low, null otherwise

joins.description: More columns of every row, kept once per paragraph text in the score store: they are those of the store row whose para_sha1 equals this row's (the path is relative to the repository root; the store has one row per para_sha1). A row with no store row is a text not scored yet: bpb null here, these columns null too. Every text ever scored stays in the store, even after it leaves the corpus.

columns.score_run: the scoring run that scored this text (see 'runs' in bpb.json): 1 = the full run, later runs = texts that were new after a corpus rebuild; a text found in several paragraphs of one run gets the mean
columns.bytes: UTF-8 bytes scored (pieces are stripped, so this can be a few bytes under the raw paragraph)
columns.bits: -sum(log2 p) over the tokens; bpb = bits / bytes
columns.pieces: pieces the paragraph was split into (1 unless over 1,000 characters)
